title: Optionality
hook: One client, one platform, one plan feels focused. Right up until one of them disappears.
statement: Keep your future choices open, and create new ones on purpose. Options are protection.
explainer: Plans fail. When yours does, real alternatives let you pivot instead of panic. Closing doors you don't have to close leaves you with nowhere to go.
sop: List the big decisions coming up this quarter.
Mark each as reversible or permanent. Permanent ones get extra scrutiny.
Rate the Value of each Live Option from 1 to 10.
Before closing a high-value option, ask what you'd lose if the plan fails.
Create one new option this month: a second buyer, income stream, or skill.
equation_example: 3 Live Options with an average Value of 7. 3 × 7 = 21. Higher means you've got real alternatives if the main plan fails. Lower means one bad break leaves you with no moves.
question: Name one option you're about to close that you should keep open.
closing_statement: Keep more doors open than you close.
caption:
Principle Nº 178: Optionality

One client, one platform, one plan feels focused. Right up until one of them disappears.

Keep your future choices open, and create new ones on purpose. Options are protection.

Your turn: Name one option you're about to close that you should keep open.
